question: What sum of money (in ₹) will amount to ₹2,280 in 4 years at 5% per annum simple interest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Simple Interest percentage = 4 years × 5% = 20%

Total Amount percentage = Principal (100%) + Interest (20%) = 120%

According to the given question, 120% → ₹2,280

100% → (2280 ÷ 120) × 100

Principal = 19 × 100 = 1900

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,900.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount (A) = ₹2,280

Rate of Interest (R) = 5% per annum

Time (T) = 4 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

SI = (P × R × T)
